notes.title: Experienced beta testers wanted.
notes.content:
Experienced beta testers wanted.

If you like to help me please contact me here.

Search:
- up to 10 beta testers needed
- search for memory leaks
- Determination of minimum requirements

Offer:
- Steam Key for the current pre-release version (full version on release included)

Requirements:
- Windows 10
- Around 60 minutes of test time (run program in wallpaper mode)
- 3GB download traffic, about 3 GB of storage space

Expectations:
- Technical details about the computer (operating system, DirectX, CPU, RAM, graphics card)
- Short Report about Performance
- bug reports, errors and problems
